title: 18. Areas Where Panchayati Raj Does NOT Apply

blocks.content:
The provisions do not apply to:
• Scheduled Areas
• Tribal Areas
• Certain hill regions

However, PESA Act (1996) extended provisions to Scheduled Areas.
However, PESA Act (1996) extended provisions to Scheduled Areas.

items: Remember that Panchayati Raj does NOT inherently apply to Scheduled Areas, Tribal Areas, and certain hill regions.
PESA Act (1996) specifically extended Panchayati Raj provisions to Scheduled Areas.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Panchayati Raj provisions are not automatically applicable to Scheduled Areas, Tribal Areas, and certain hill regions.
The PESA Act was enacted in 1996 to extend these provisions to Scheduled Areas.
